_comment: First-run onboarding: FIFA 21's own first-run flow (country, club creation, loan, kits, badge), see ultimateteam/onboarding.md. The screens, request shapes and the nine countries are the game's; every pool, count and rating below is local policy, not recovered EA data.
_countryNationsComment: The nine countries the country screen offers, in its order (CardsDLL 0x2A54BB): England, Brazil, France, Argentina, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Holland. Its ONBOARDING_COUNTRY_<n>_SELECTED action names the 1-based position, not the nation id.
_starterComment: The starter squad CreateUser grants (owner-approved retail-like policy, 2026-09-28; the Python server's onboarding.py; gold commons and rares since the owner's phase-1 call, 2026-09-29): one untradeable base card (rareflag at most maxRareflag, not special) per listed position, rated minRating to maxRating. Each slot draws at random, seeded by the club, from the `candidates` eligible cards rated closest to targetRating; every other slot (the first, third, ...) draws from the chosen country's players when it has any. The positions are the formation's 11 starters in its slot order, then the 7 substitutes and 5 reserves. A manager of the chosen country (any, when it has none) rated at most managerMaxRating completes the club.
_loansComment: The loan screen (retail-like, owner 2026-09-28): for each position, the playersPerPosition highest-rated base cards (rareflag at most maxRareflag, not special, not grant-only; ties by lowest id) of footballers the club does not own yet, ranked 1..playersPerPosition, loaned for `games` matches. A club FIFA created owns only its starters, so it is offered each position's best; a seeded club, which already owns the best base cards, is offered the next best (up to offerIdsPerPosition deep). FIFA's picker shows five: offers for the position being improved first, then the other positions' number ones. Offer ids are local: firstOfferId + position index × offerIdsPerPosition + the card's place in its position's list, so an offer keeps its id whatever the club owns.
_cosmeticsComment: The kit and badge screens offer a random choice per club, as retail did (seeded by the club, so every visit shows the same choices): homeChoices home kits and awayChoices away kits from the catalogue's pack kits, and `choices` club badges. The chosen ones are granted untradeable and equipped. The kit screen is a 3x3 grid that shows one list at a time (home, then away) and draws an empty white shirt in every slot left over, so each list fills all nine (owner's screenshot, 2026-09-29: five kits and four blank shirts). The badge screen is assumed to use the same grid.
